notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature card in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Rosie Cotton by paying {2}{W}.
When Rosie Cotton enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a Food token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Rosie Cotton's second ability and Golbez trigger.
Resolve the Rosie Cotton trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Holding priority, activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting an artifact creature card from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Golbez ability, putting the artifact creature card from the top of your library into your graveyard.
Unshakable Tail triggers, creating a Clue token.
Repeat from step 3.
